warmup.description: Gentle joint circles to bring blood flow to the areas you'll work.

main_exercises.name: Foam rolling pass (calves, quads, upper back)
main_exercises.form_cue: Roll slowly, pause on tender spots rather than rolling through them

main_exercises.name: Long-held stretches (hip flexor, hamstring, chest)
main_exercises.form_cue: Breathe into the stretch, ease deeper on the exhale rather than forcing it

cooldown.description: Settle into stillness and let the nervous system downshift.
